item.title: EAEU’s highest honor medal awarded to Iran’s industry minister
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) has awarded its highest honor medal to Iran’s Minister of Industry, Mine and Trade Mohammad Atabak, in recognition of his efforts to expand economic cooperation and strengthen trade ties between Iran and the bloc’s member states.

Tehran, IRNA – The Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) has awarded its highest honor medal to Iran’s Minister of Industry, Mine and Trade Mohammad Atabak, in recognition of his efforts to expand economic cooperation and strengthen trade ties between Iran and the bloc’s member states.

item.title: Iranian Army spokesperson: US facing strategic isolation
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akrami-Nia says the United States launched an illegal war against Iran with the aim of destroying Iranian-Islamic civilization, but has now found itself strategically isolated for the first time since World War II, with even its closest allies refusing to come to its aid.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86293244/Iranian-Army-spokesperson-US-facing-strategic-isolation

Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Army spokesperson Brigadier General Mohammad Akrami-Nia says the United States launched an illegal war against Iran with the aim of destroying Iranian-Islamic civilization, but has now found itself strategically isolated for the first time since World War II, with even its closest allies refusing to come to its aid.
